live_readonly_snapshot_handoff.handoff_note: Optional advisory source-freshness evidence for operator status and FrankenTUI dashboard handoffs. It must not be described as a live capture daemon, scheduler, Agent Mail client, resource planner, worker controller, or queue mutation surface.

renderer.handoff_note: franken_engine produces JSON fixtures; /dp/frankentui owns rich interactive rendering.

telemetry_snapshot_normalizer.handoff_note: The standalone snapshot normalizer reuses admission, archive, proof-economy, and SWARM-CTRL-IX high-core evidence artifacts directly. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit either snapshot yet.

high_core_scenario_matrix.handoff_note: The standalone high-core scenario matrix replays deterministic SWARM-CTRL-IX calibration scenarios through the telemetry snapshot normalizer and freezes scrubbed representative outputs as reviewed goldens. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit or compare this matrix yet.

slo_calibrator.handoff_note: The standalone SWARM-CTRL-IX calibrator composes the reviewed high-core scenario matrix, telemetry snapshot, archive pressure scoreboard, and warm-target ROI advisory into deterministic advisory thresholds. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this receipt yet.

capacity_forecaster.handoff_note: The standalone capacity forecaster consumes the telemetry snapshot plus its normalized child artifacts to publish deterministic confidence-banded risk categories. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this forecast yet.

admission_budget_planner.handoff_note: The standalone admission budget planner consumes the predictive capacity forecast plus bounded request fixtures to publish deterministic per-priority and per-agent admission budgets. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this budget plan yet.

slo_tuning_advisory.handoff_note: The standalone SWARM-CTRL-IX operator SLO tuning advisory composes the reviewed threshold receipt, capacity forecast, chaos conformance report, admission budget plan, lease exchange salvage simulation, and warm-target ROI advisory into bounded operator recommendations. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this advisory yet.

starvation_rescue_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report now integrates the starvation rescue planner plus the ownership-safe conformance report into one advisory-only rescue handoff. It must not be described as a second predictive dashboard producer, a live reopen controller, or an automatic ownership transfer surface.

checkpoint_restore_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report now integrates checkpoint bundle capture truth, the restore planner, and the restore conformance report into one advisory-only restore handoff. It must not be described as live checkpoint replay, automatic worker mutation, or automatic ownership transfer.

execution_queue_advisory.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates execution queue runner artifacts as advisory-only queue evidence. It must not be described as live bead mutation, automatic reopen, reassignment, or a second dashboard producer. If checkpoint restore evidence is blocked or manual-review, the queue advisory must surface that dependency instead of overriding it.

queue_fidelity_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates queue fidelity, drift, and counterfactual tuning artifacts as advisory-only hindsight evidence. It must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic bead changes, or a second dashboard producer.

queue_tuning_promotion_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates final queue tuning promotion artifacts as advisory-only operator evidence. It must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic promotion, or a second dashboard producer.

queue_policy_adoption_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates queue policy adoption history, sustained-gain results, and expiry/supersession advisory artifacts. It must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic retirement, automatic supersession, or evidence that retirement already executed.

readiness_policy.complete: required claim, reservation, validation, and closeout commit edges are present with no anomalies
readiness_policy.degraded: optional trace snapshots are missing or only degraded anomalies are present
readiness_policy.blocked: an in-progress bead is missing required handoff edges
readiness_policy.contaminated: fail-closed anomaly evidence invalidates closeout trust

swarm_agent_causal_trace_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates causal trace graph and anomaly artifacts as advisory-only handoff evidence. It must not be described as live Agent Mail querying, automatic reservation release, automatic bead repair, rch execution, Cargo execution, or queue mutation.

readiness_policy.ready: resource envelope and fair-share plan are present, coherent, and admit work
readiness_policy.degraded: optional resource evidence is missing or degraded but not saturated or contaminated
readiness_policy.blocked: capacity evidence is trustworthy but saturated, so heavy work should be deferred
readiness_policy.contaminated: fail-closed or local-fallback capacity evidence invalidates admission

swarm_resource_envelope_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates resource envelope and fair-share batch-plan artifacts as advisory-only admission evidence. It must not be described as live queue mutation, automatic bead reassignment, automatic RCH or Cargo execution, target-dir cleanup, worker mutation, or a second dashboard producer.

readiness_policy.ready: placement plan, receipt, and evidence ledger are present with adopted locality and cache-residency assumptions
readiness_policy.degraded: placement evidence has drift, expiry, pending observation, or degraded cache-residency assumptions
readiness_policy.blocked: placement plan or receipt is non-adoptable because locality evidence is blocked
readiness_policy.contaminated: fail-closed evidence or unsafe mutation claims invalidate placement advice

swarm_topology_placement_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates topology placement plan, receipt, and evidence-ledger artifacts as advisory-only locality and cache-residency evidence. It must not be described as live queue mutation, automatic worker pinning, automatic host rebinding, automatic target-dir repair, automatic placement enforcement, RCH or Cargo execution, or worker mutation.

readiness_policy.ready: topology-aware queue advisory evidence is confirmed, coherent, and safe to use as operator guidance
readiness_policy.degraded: locality or cache-reuse evidence is incomplete but not contradictory or contaminated
readiness_policy.blocked: queue-locality evidence is contradictory or explicitly blocks routing confidence
readiness_policy.contaminated: local fallback, unsafe mutation claims, or fail-closed evidence invalidate queue-locality advice

swarm_topology_aware_queue_advisory_hand.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates topology-aware queue scorer artifacts as advisory-only queue-locality evidence. It must not be described as live queue mutation, automatic worker pinning, automatic task rerouting, automatic queue retuning, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or worker mutation.

readiness_policy.ready: benchmark catalog and responsiveness advisory evidence are confirmed, coherent, and safe to use as operator guidance
readiness_policy.degraded: benchmark evidence is stale, saturated, or incomplete but not blocked or contaminated
readiness_policy.blocked: throughput measurement remains blocked and cannot support readiness claims
readiness_policy.contaminated: local fallback, unsafe mutation claims, or fail-closed benchmark evidence invalidate the advisory

swarm_benchmark_responsiveness_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates workload-catalog and responsiveness-scorer artifacts as advisory-only benchmark evidence. It must not be described as live benchmark execution, automatic queue mutation, automatic worker mutation, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or automatic claim of measurement truth.

readiness_policy.ready: actionability report is fresh, advisory-only, and can be used as safe claim guidance
readiness_policy.degraded: actionability report is fresh but only supports defer or observe-only claim guidance
readiness_policy.blocked: actionability report fails closed on blocked or divergent claimability evidence
readiness_policy.contaminated: stale exported state or unsafe mutation claims invalidate actionability guidance

swarm_actionability_guard_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates actionability guard artifacts as advisory-only claim-preflight evidence. It must not be described as live bead mutation, automatic claim execution, automatic reopen, automatic reassignment, Agent Mail mutation, Git mutation, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or queue mutation.

readiness_policy.actionable: next first-error recommendation is target-relevant and clear of ownership blockers
readiness_policy.duplicate: recommendation matches an existing bead and should not create duplicate work
readiness_policy.deferred: recommendation is behind active owner or reservation evidence
readiness_policy.blocked: recommendation has insufficient evidence for source-fix work
readiness_policy.contaminated: fail-closed or unsafe mutation evidence invalidates the conveyor plan

first_error_conveyor_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates first-error conveyor plans as advisory-only compile-blocker handoff evidence. It must not be described as live bead creation, automatic ownership transfer, Agent Mail mutation, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or a second dashboard producer.

readiness_policy.ready: capability-affinity advisory and outcome ledger agree on a safe worker cohort with no mismatch, capability-gap, or toolchain-drift findings
readiness_policy.degraded: routing evidence remains coherent but broader-cohort fallback, mismatches, or degraded supporting evidence reduce confidence
readiness_policy.blocked: required capability coverage or toolchain parity is insufficient for safe routing
readiness_policy.contaminated: fail-closed or unsafe mutation claims invalidate remote-only capability-affinity advice

swarm_capability_affinity_routing_handof.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates capability-affinity routing advisory and outcome-ledger artifacts as advisory-only worker-cohort and toolchain-safe routing evidence. It must not be described as live queue mutation, automatic task rerouting, automatic worker mutation, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or worker mutation.

readiness_policy.ready: catalog, intent-router, and drift-gate artifacts agree on an advisory-only surface recommendation
readiness_policy.degraded: one catalog-routing artifact is missing or degraded but no fail-closed or blocked condition is present
readiness_policy.blocked: intent routing is blocked by active ownership or explicit route blockers
readiness_policy.contaminated: catalog, router, or drift evidence fails closed or claims unsafe mutation authority

swarm_control_surface_catalog_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates control-surface catalog, intent-router, and drift-gate artifacts as advisory-only routing evidence. It must not be described as a second dashboard producer, live bead mutation, automatic remediation, automatic worker mutation, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or queue mutation.

truth_constraints: No rich interactive renderer is implemented in franken_engine by this contract.
Any future rich TUI dashboard must be implemented through /dp/frankentui or an explicit ADR exception.
The producer must remain snapshot-fed and must not claim beads, query services, or run cargo commands.
scripts/swarm_operator_status_report.sh remains the single predictive dashboard producer in franken_engine; do not add a second dashboard implementation here.

The optional live_readonly_snapshot section is advisory source-freshness evidence backed by scripts/swarm_live_readonly_snapshot_bundle.sh; it must not be described as a scheduler, live capture daemon, resource planner, Agent Mail client, RCH executor, Cargo executor, worker mutation surface, or replacement for bd-eozx0/bd-x82vp authority.

The high-core scenario matrix is a reviewed fixture and golden surface backed by scripts/swarm_high_core_slo_scenario_matrix.sh; it must not be described as live scheduler tuning, live worker execution, or automatic worker mutation.

The telemetry quality and capacity forecast sections are advisory snapshots backed by scripts/swarm_capacity_forecaster.sh; they must not be described as live scheduling or automatic worker mutation.

The admission budget section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_admission_budget_planner.sh; it must not be described as live worker allocation, queue mutation, or automatic bead claiming.

The checkpoint restore section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by docs/SWARM_CHECKPOINT_BUNDLE_CONTRACT.md, scripts/swarm_checkpoint_restore_planner.sh, and scripts/swarm_checkpoint_restore_conformance_gate.sh; it must not be described as live checkpoint replay, automatic worker mutation, or automatic ownership transfer.

The topology placement section is advisory locality and cache-residency evidence backed by scripts/swarm_topology_placement_planner.sh and scripts/swarm_topology_placement_receipt_ledger.sh; it must not be described as live worker pinning, host rebinding, queue mutation, placement enforcement, target-dir repair, RCH execution, Cargo execution, or worker mutation.
